Chapter 1 partner choice第一章同伴选择

Scherazard

Choose her for flexible support, arts access and turn control. Her orbment layout favors a caster-support role.适合重视支援、魔法覆盖与行动控制的队伍。导力器结构偏向魔法支援。

Agate

Choose him for direct physical damage, CP pressure and fast removal of priority targets.适合直接物理输出、CP 爆发和快速清除高优先级目标。

The choice remains locked until Chapter 4. Both routes are viable; pick the role your Estelle setup lacks.该选择会锁定到第四章。两条路线都可行，优先补足艾丝蒂尔当前配装缺少的定位。

Four useful roles四种实用定位

Breaker破防手

Physical pressure, CP recovery and crafts that control a priority target.负责物理压制、CP 循环和控制高优先级目标。

Arts attacker魔法输出

Keeps more than one element ready to answer resistance and physical reflect.准备多个属性，应对抗性和物理反射。

Support支援

Speed, healing and turn-order tools. Acts before damage dealers when possible.提供速度、回复和行动轴工具，尽量先于输出角色行动。

Field sustain续航位

Reduces EP and item use between checkpoints so burst resources remain ready.降低检查点之间的 EP 与道具消耗，保留爆发资源。
